description: This is a Java JUnit test class for the class RetrieveAttributesStrategy. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior and immutability of RetrieveAttributesStrategy methods, focusing on retrieving attributes from a 'Thing' object with and without selected fields, and handling missing attributes scenarios.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RetrieveAttributesStrategy, testing attribute retrieval logic, immutability, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RetrieveAttributesStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks if RetrieveAttributesStrategy class instances are immutable.

methods.name: retrieveAttributesWithoutSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving attributes without specifying particular fields, expecting the full attribute set.

methods.name: retrieveAttributesWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving attributes with specified fields, verifying selective attribute retrieval.

methods.name: retrieveAttributesFromThingWithoutAttributes
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to retrieve attributes from a 'Thing' that lacks attributes, expecting an exception.
